statement: The function returns a result r, and r = min { W(j) | 0 <= j <= len(blocks)-k }, where W(j) is the number of indices i with j <= i < j+k and blocks[i] = 87 (ASCII 'W'). Equivalently, for every j with 0 <= j <= len(blocks)-k we have r <= W(j), and there exists at least one j with 0 <= j <= len(blocks)-k such that W(j) = r.
